summary: Flat kerb under trees, but houses 11-13 m away on the same side.

best_section.where: West kerb of Hillsdon Road, north of the bus zone, under the trees

drivers.traffic: Collector road with moderate traffic and school-run activity.
drivers.convention: One car parked in line; signs show bus zone and 10 minute school-hour parking.
